SELECTED_INDEX: 3
CONFIDENCE: 0.68
EXPLANATION: The spectrum shows a very strong benzene ring-breathing band at ~1006 cm⁻¹ (characteristic of para-disubstituted benzenes), strong aromatic C=C around 1607 cm⁻¹, and aromatic C–H stretches near 3073–3115 cm⁻¹. Crucially, there are bands consistent with an amide: amide I near 1647–1673 cm⁻¹ and amide II near 1555 cm⁻¹ (typical for acetanilide-type structures), while no O–H broad stretch (~3400–3600 cm⁻¹; GFQ-001) or S–H stretch (~2550–2620 cm⁻¹; GFQ-005) is observed, excluding acids (1,2,5) and thiols (4,7). Multiple bands at 1134–1222 cm⁻¹ support aryl C–F stretching. Candidate 3 (para-fluoroacetanilide-type) matches these features best; nitro-containing pyridine (8) would explain 1333/1607 as NO₂ modes (GFQ-022) but lacks the carbonyl-derived amide I band at 1647–1673 and the strong para-benzene ring-breathing at 1006.
